svg.text: Every weekday at 9, sort my unread email and tell me what needs me.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Done. I’ll do it every weekday morning and stay quiet when nothing’s new.

svg.text: If Acme replies, draft my answer — I’ll send it.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Acme replied. Here’s a draft — nothing goes out until you press Send.

svg.text: Hi Jane — thanks for the quick reply. The revised quote is attached;

svg.text: the lead time stays at three weeks. Happy to jump on a call Thursday.
